Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the quick follow up. Yep — happy to do a 30m sync. Quick answers below so you can prep: 

Use case: conversational search for internal knowledge base + customer support triage (mix of short queries and full‑document retrieval). Example: agent asks “what was the resolution to ticket #3421” and we want a concise summary + link.

Traffic: currently ~1k queries/day, expected to ramp to 10–15k/day over the quarter. Peak concurrency around 20–30 reqs/minute during office hours. Avg request ~400 tokens (many are retrieval + condense).

Timeline: pilot in next 2–4 weeks; broader rollout in 2‑3 months if pilot looks good.

Compliance: we have SSO via Okta and need audit logs; nothing air‑gapped for now.

I can do Wed 3/7 at 16:00 PT but need to push to 16:30 if that’s possible — 30m still works. Attaching a quick traffic snapshot.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Data Products, Findly
alex.rivera@findly.ai | +1 650‑555‑0123
